news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹33.12 (up from ₹27.83 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹532.2b (up 7.0% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹33.7b (up 20% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.3% (up from 5.7% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 6.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Metals and Mining industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 14% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 29% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
